<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one signal appears in the typical methyl carbon region (≈10‑30 ppm), at 19.23 ppm. The other aliphatic signals are at higher ppm (≈43‑52 ppm), corresponding to carbons attached to heteroatoms or CH₂ groups, not methyls. Therefore the molecule contains a single CH₃ group.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
